answers.Which increment are we exploring?: The 'Display and Load Instructions' increment — a new feature for the architecture_reference extension panel that enables users to see the instructions for the currently selected behavior and action.
answers.What is the overarching outcome or user: A user navigating behaviors and actions in the panel wants to read the relevant instructions for the current step — the behavior's guidance and the action's merged instructions (from base + behavior config) — without leaving the panel.
answers.What is the first thing the user will tr: Select (click) a behavior or action in the behavior tree and expect to see its instructions content displayed in a dedicated instructions area in the panel.
answers.What system reactions are expected for e: Selecting a behavior: panel shows behavior's instructions[] array. Selecting an action: panel shows action's merged instructions[]. Navigating via Next/Back: panel updates instruction content reactively. Server (_postCurrentState) must include instructions in its message to the client.
answers.Where do we 'pass the ball' between the: User clicks behavior/action in tree → BotBehaviorClient.navigateToBehavior/Action() → server _postCurrentState() includes instructions in message → client receives and renders to instructions-panel DOM element → user reads instructions.
answers.What are the likely unknowns, edge cases: Empty instructions arrays require placeholder text. Initial panel open needs instructions populated from hydration payload. Merged vs unmerged instructions for actions (actions already merged in loadActions()). Stale instructions if navigation state diverges.
answers.Are there domain rules or constraints th: Action instructions are already merged by domain loadActions(): base action instructions[] first, then behavior workflow entry instructions[]. Behavior instructions are in IBehaviorConfig.instructions[]. Both can be empty arrays. The client already possesses instruction data post-loadBehaviors().
answers.What parts of this increment are likely: Server BotBehaviorView._postCurrentState() must include behaviorInstructions and actionInstructions in the posted message. BotBehaviorHydrateData may need extension to carry instructions on panel open. answers.Where do we face architectural risk or u: Risk: client already has instructions via this.currentBehavior?.instructions after loadBehaviors — may be handled client-side without extra server round-trip. Need to decide whether instructions display is client-driven (read from local domain state) or server-driven (wait for _postCurrentState message). Current hydration mechanism (BotBehaviorHydrateData) can be extended without breaking changes.
